title: CAPIT Privacy Policy
description: Learn what information CAPIT collects, how it is used, and what happens when you browse or connect a wallet.
headline: Privacy Policy
body: This Privacy Policy explains how CAPIT collects, uses, shares, and retains information when you visit the registry, read content, submit a form, connect a wallet, or interact with embedded third-party services.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.body: We may collect information you provide directly, such as your contact information when submitting an inquiry. Technical usage data (e.g., browser type, approximate location, referring URLs) may also be collected to maintain system stability.

sections.heading: Public Blockchain Data
sections.body: Connecting a wallet surfaces your public wallet address and network metadata to facilitate protocol interactions. CAPIT never asks for or stores private keys, seed phrases, or wallet passwords.
